verdict.rationale: Resend's pricing page says that for the provisioned resource it will "warmup, monitor, and autoscale it based on your utilization," which points to a managed, automated ramp-up. This rests on a single marketing line, and the quoted span does not even name the dedicated IP explicitly. missing for 10: explicit dedicated-IP documentation, warmup mechanics or a published ramp-up schedule, eligibility or volume thresholds for moving off shared pools, plan availability details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a deliverability manager, I can get dedicated IPs with documented warmup — automated ramp-up or a published warmup schedule — when my volume outgrows shared pools

citations.quote: We will warmup, monitor, and autoscale it based on your utilization so you can focus on one thing, sending.
